item.title: Southern Cross Electrical Engineering Awarded Data Centre and Rail Contracts Totalling $90 Million
item.description: Southern Cross Electrical Engineering (ASX: SXE) has secured awards totalling $90 million across the data centre and rail sectors through various group subsidiaries.

item.title: Barton Gold Reports New Assays from Drilling at Tunkillia S1 Starter Pit
item.description: New assays from drilling at Barton Gold’s (ASX: BGD) (OTCQB: BGDFF) Tunkillia project in South Australia have provided indications of higher-grade vertical structures at shallow depth in the system.

item.title: Hawthorn Resources Reports Strong Resource Upgrade Drilling Results at Anglo Saxon Gold Project
item.description: Hawthorn Resources (ASX: HAW) has delivered high-grade results from a major drilling program at its Anglo Saxon gold project within the Trouser Legs joint venture in Western Australia.

item.title: Greenvale Energy Achieves Key Milestones at Alpha Torbanite Project
item.description: Greenvale Energy (ASX: GRV) has successfully completed the first two milestones of Test Program 7 at its Alpha Torbanite project in Queensland, with bulk sample production now underway.

item.title: Gold Hydrogen Further Confirms Potential of Ramsay Gas Development in SA
item.description: Gold Hydrogen (ASX: GHY) has taken a key step in realising the commercial potential of its Ramsay gas development in South Australia with drilling success at the Ramsay 4 well.

item.title: Viking Mines to Acquire High-Grade USA Tungsten Projects after Successful Placement
item.description: Viking Mines (ASX: VKA) has entered into a binding terms sheet to acquire 100% of six tungsten projects in Nevada, with American Tungsten making a $750,000 strategic investment and providing in-country technical services.

item.title: Yugo Metals Completes European Exchange Listings as Sinjakovo Drilling Progresses
item.description: Yugo Metals (ASX: YUG) has successfully completed its dual listing on the Frankfurt and Dusseldorf stock exchanges, aimed at increasing its exposure to European institutional and retail investors.

item.title: Emyria Establishes First Victorian Empax Clinic for Psychedelic-Assisted Treatments
item.description: Perth-based mental health care specialist Emyria (ASX: EMD) has secured its first Empax clinic in Victoria for the psychedelic-assisted treatment of post-traumatic stress disorder (PTSD) and treatment-resistant depression.

item.title: Black Bear Minerals to Commence Trading on US OTCQX Market as Shafter Silver Project Drilling Gets Underway
item.description: Black Bear Minerals (ASX: BKB) will commence trading on the US OTCQX Market tonight, marking a major milestone in the company's US expansion as it commences its maiden drilling program at the high-grade Shafter silver project in Texas.

item.title: Sierra Nevada Gold Wins Tender for Advanced As Safra project in Saudi Arabia
item.description: Sierra Nevada Gold (ASX: SNX) has been awarded the highly prospective As Safra copper-gold project in Saudi Arabia after a competitive tender process with Saudi Arabia’s Ministry of Industry and Mineral Resources.
